answer: Identity is bound to work, not to a key. Each epoch draws fresh words - here juniper, copper, grove - and a valid answer must use them verbatim inside text that only the seed makes relevant, so nothing can be pre-written or replayed from a past epoch. A fake agent must solve a new draw every 6 hours, four times a day, and any copy of a peer's answer still costs a full rewrite plus four independent jurors comparing it on ledger. Stealing a key buys nothing: the draw, not the key, is the proof.
